cases.note: The case §86 exists for: an arm on position and wheels on velocity, bound together. Before this section the body declared no control modes at all and every channel was blocked.

cases.note: The same policy and the same machine behind a driver that reads one mode per command. The two velocity channels are blocked **by name** rather than dropped, so a required one refuses the plan — the alternative an integration reaches for is to command the joints sharing the majority mode and move two thirds of the robot.
cases.expected: {"bindings":[{"limit":3,"method":"remap","reason":"Mapped by role right_arm.shoulder.pitch to \"shoulder\".","scale":1,"source_index":0,"source_role":"right_arm.shoulder.pitch","target":"shoulder"},{"limit":3,"method":"remap","reason":"Mapped by role right_arm.elbow.flex to \"elbow\".","scale":1,"source_index":1,"source_role":"right_arm.elbow.flex","target":"elbow"},{"limit":2,"method":"blocked","reason":"This driver does not declare per-joint modes (§86.1), and the body is already commanded in position.","scale":1,"source_index":2,"source_role":"base.wheel#0","target":"wheel_l"},{"limit":2,"method":"blocked","reason":"This driver does not declare per-joint modes (§86.1), and the body is already commanded in position.","scale":1,"source_index":3,"source_role":"base.wheel#1","target":"wheel_r"}],"clamp":{"joint_modes":{"elbow":"position","shoulder":"position"},"joint_torque_max_nm":60,"joint_velocity_max_rad_s":1.5,"min_control_hz":10,"per_channel":{"elbow":3,"shoulder":3},"source":"https://example.invalid/mobile.pdf","travel":{"elbow":[-3,3],"shoulder":[-3,3]}},"control_hz":50,"control_mode":"position","observations":[],"robot_slug":"test-mobile-manipulator-v1","source_digest":"sha256:policy","target_digest":"sha256:mobile-v1","verdict":"refused","warnings":[{"code":"mixed_modes_unsupported","message":"This body is already commanded in position and its driver reads one mode per command, so the velocity channel on \"wheel_l\" cannot be delivered.","subjects":["wheel_l"]},{"code":"mixed_modes_unsupported","message":"This body is already commanded in position and its driver reads one mode per command, so the velocity channel on \"wheel_r\" cannot be delivered.","subjects":["wheel_r"]}]}

cases.note: Declaration order decides on a v1 driver, not joint count: the same four channels with the two wheels first leave the wheels commanded and the arm blocked.

cases.note: Two channels onto one joint in two modes is refused on any driver (§86.2): they would meet as one entry in `values` and one in `modes`, and the command would carry whichever was written last. First-wins, as §84.3 does with a repeated motion.
cases.expected: {"bindings":[{"limit":3,"method":"direct","reason":"Joint name matches exactly.","scale":1,"source_index":0,"source_role":"right_arm.shoulder.pitch","target":"shoulder"},{"limit":2,"method":"blocked","reason":"\"shoulder\" does not accept velocity commands.","scale":1,"source_index":1,"source_role":"right_arm.shoulder.pitch","target":"shoulder"}],"clamp":{"joint_modes":{"shoulder":"position"},"joint_torque_max_nm":60,"joint_velocity_max_rad_s":1.5,"min_control_hz":10,"per_channel":{"shoulder":3},"source":"https://example.invalid/mobile.pdf","travel":{"shoulder":[-3,3]}},"control_hz":50,"control_mode":"position","observations":[],"robot_slug":"test-mobile-manipulator","source_digest":"sha256:policy","target_digest":"sha256:mobile","verdict":"refused","warnings":[{"code":"unmapped_roles","message":"3 joints on this body are not driven by the policy and will be held by the controller.","subjects":["right_arm.elbow.flex","base.wheel#0","base.wheel#1"]}]}

cases.note: The same conflict on a body every joint of which is one mode. The refusal is §86.2's and not §86.1's: the joint itself cannot be in two modes, whatever the driver reads.
cases.expected: {"bindings":[{"limit":60,"method":"direct","reason":"Joint name matches exactly.","scale":1,"source_index":0,"source_role":"right_arm.elbow.flex","target":"J2"},{"limit":3,"method":"blocked","reason":"\"J2\" is commanded in torque by an earlier channel, and a joint takes one mode per cycle.","scale":1,"source_index":1,"source_role":"right_arm.elbow.flex","target":"J2"}],"clamp":{"joint_modes":{"J2":"torque"},"joint_torque_max_nm":80,"joint_velocity_max_rad_s":2,"min_control_hz":10,"per_channel":{"J2":60},"source":"https://example.invalid/arm.pdf"},"control_hz":50,"control_mode":"torque","observations":[],"robot_slug":"test-arm","source_digest":"sha256:policy","target_digest":"sha256:arm","verdict":"refused","warnings":[{"code":"joint_mode_conflict","message":"\"J2\" is already bound in torque; a joint carries one mode per cycle, so this position channel is blocked.","subjects":["J2"]},{"code":"unmapped_roles","message":"2 joints on this body are not driven by the policy and will be held by the controller.","subjects":["right_arm.shoulder.pitch","right_arm.wrist.roll"]}]}

cases.note: The map is not a mixed-body feature. Every plan that binds a joint carries the mode each one is commanded in, because the kernel needs the units on a single-mode body exactly as much.

cases.note: A joint whose mode the body does not accept is blocked, and contributes neither a ceiling nor a mode — the kernel must not read a ceiling in the units of a command that is not going out.

cases.note: The v1 refusal respects `optional` exactly as every other block does: the two velocity channels are still blocked and named, and the plan is refused because they are required. Marked optional they would degrade instead — this is the required half, and the `degraded` half is the case below.
cases.expected: {"bindings":[{"limit":3,"method":"remap","reason":"Mapped by role right_arm.shoulder.pitch to \"shoulder\".","scale":1,"source_index":0,"source_role":"right_arm.shoulder.pitch","target":"shoulder"},{"limit":2,"method":"blocked","reason":"This driver does not declare per-joint modes (§86.1), and the body is already commanded in position.","scale":1,"source_index":1,"source_role":"base.wheel#0","target":"wheel_l"}],"clamp":{"joint_modes":{"shoulder":"position"},"joint_torque_max_nm":60,"joint_velocity_max_rad_s":1.5,"min_control_hz":10,"per_channel":{"shoulder":3},"source":"https://example.invalid/mobile.pdf","travel":{"shoulder":[-3,3]}},"control_hz":50,"control_mode":"position","observations":[],"robot_slug":"test-mobile-manipulator-v1","source_digest":"sha256:policy","target_digest":"sha256:mobile-v1","verdict":"refused","warnings":[{"code":"mixed_modes_unsupported","message":"This body is already commanded in position and its driver reads one mode per command, so the velocity channel on \"wheel_l\" cannot be delivered.","subjects":["wheel_l"]},{"code":"unmapped_roles","message":"2 joints on this body are not driven by the policy and will be held by the controller.","subjects":["right_arm.elbow.flex","base.wheel#1"]}]}

cases.note: And it does **not** degrade. `optional` is consulted when no target exists on the body; here the joint exists, accepts the mode, and cannot be reached in the same command — which is the precedent a joint that refuses the mode already set (`mode-refused`). A channel silently dropped is the failure this section is written against.
